items.title: John Abercrombie interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 19, 2001
items.q: I’ve gotten a chance to play with Jim... We’ve done some on concerts

ctx.x: Anybody, just to wrap up, that you haven’t played with that you wish you could?

Well I’ve always said I mean it’s probably because of my connection to Jim Hall and what he did with Sonny Rollins, I’ve gotten a chance to play with Jim, although I’d like to play with him a little more I mean maybe just one on one, that would be great. We’ve done some on concerts but it’s never been real just sitting down in a room and playing you know. That would be very cool, I’d like to do that. But I’d love to play with Sonny © Fillius Jazz Archive -25-

Rollins. And one drummer that, I’ve played with a lot of the great drummers, DeJohnette, I’ve played with Roy Haynes a few times and I’ve played with you know Billy Hart and just Peter Erskine, Adam Nussbaum, just a whole slew of great drummers, but I haven’t played with Elvin Jones. And I just think that’s got to be great. I mean how can that not be great? I mean it’s impossible, that would be impossible not to feel great playing with him, I mean that’s just — he’s sort of like the epitome somehow of a certain…
